$comment: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025-2026 Andrei Nicolae Besleaga. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Draft bridge registry. Status is 'planned' for every entry because no bridge has been implemented or tested. A bridge must not be claimed as supported until it passes stored fixtures (CONFORMANCE.md CON-MUSTNOT-003). Profile classification follows the proposal in docs/adr/0003-core-and-extended-profiles.md and is not yet decided. Core is limited to the native internal transport plus the agent-interoperability protocols.

profileRules.core: Proposed: the native internal transport plus the agent-interoperability protocols required for baseline interoperation.
profileRules.extension: Proposed: everything else, published as independently versioned extension packs.

bridges.name: gRPC
bridges.fidelityNotes: Internal transport baseline (CON-CORE-006). Not a translation target so much as the native transport.

bridges.name: A2A
bridges.fidelityNotes: Agent interoperability target. Foreign revision not yet pinned; see STANDARDS-VERSIONS.md.

bridges.name: MCP
bridges.fidelityNotes: Tool and context interoperability target. Foreign revision not yet pinned.

bridges.name: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2
bridges.fidelityNotes: Request and response semantics do not map cleanly to an event envelope; streaming bodies have no AGCP representation. Not part of the proposed core: a web protocol is not the native internal transport.

bridges.name: WebSocket
bridges.fidelityNotes: Full-duplex framing must be modelled as a session, not a single message. Not part of the proposed core: a web protocol is not the native internal transport.

bridges.name: MQTT 5.0
bridges.fidelityNotes: QoS 1 and 2 duplicate delivery must be reconciled with envelope id deduplication. Retained messages and will messages have no direct AGCP equivalent.

bridges.name: AMQP 1.0
bridges.fidelityNotes: Broker-level routing and transactions do not map to a message envelope.

bridges.name: Apache Kafka
bridges.fidelityNotes: Partition ordering and offset semantics are not expressible in AGCP.

bridges.name: NATS
bridges.fidelityNotes: Subject wildcards have no direct equivalent.

bridges.name: CoAP
bridges.fidelityNotes: UDP-style confirmable messages need an explicit acknowledgement model.

bridges.name: LwM2M
bridges.fidelityNotes: Object and resource model is not representable as a message.

bridges.name: LoRaWAN
bridges.fidelityNotes: Severe payload size constraints force lossy translation; must be recorded as unmapped.

bridges.name: Zigbee
bridges.fidelityNotes: Mesh-layer addressing and commissioning are out of AGCP scope.

bridges.name: Bluetooth LE
bridges.fidelityNotes: GATT profile semantics do not map to a message envelope.

bridges.name: WebRTC
bridges.fidelityNotes: Media streams are not messages. Only the signalling channel is a plausible bridge target.

bridges.name: Modbus TCP/RTU
bridges.fidelityNotes: Poll and register semantics are stateful; a one-way translation loses coherence.

bridges.name: DNP3
bridges.fidelityNotes: Unsolicited responses, events, and time synchronisation are out of scope.

bridges.name: OPC-UA
bridges.fidelityNotes: Information model and subscriptions have no AGCP equivalent.

bridges.name: BACnet
bridges.fidelityNotes: Object and property model is not message-shaped.

bridges.name: HL7 v2
bridges.fidelityNotes: Delimiter-based, code-set dependent. Deferred: healthcare is out of the proposed core (ADR-0003).

bridges.name: HL7 FHIR
bridges.fidelityNotes: Resource-oriented REST API, not a message protocol. Deferred.

bridges.name: GraphQL
bridges.fidelityNotes: Query planning and subscriptions are not messages.

bridges.name: SQL over wire protocols
bridges.fidelityNotes: Session-oriented and stateful. Bridging a database protocol to a message envelope is a category error worth challenging.

bridges.name: SSH
bridges.fidelityNotes: Interactive session transport, not a message protocol.

bridges.name: SNMP
bridges.fidelityNotes: Polling and trap duality must be normalised.

bridges.name: LDAP
bridges.fidelityNotes: Directory search semantics are not messages.

bridges.name: SMB/CIFS
bridges.fidelityNotes: File semantics are out of scope; bridging them would be a design error.
